svg.title: Tracking Monkey Typing: commits
svg.desc: Tracking Monkey Typing shows lifetime aggregate weekly commits. Totals: 31,824 GitHub-credited commits and 27,345 authored commits. The 4,479-commit gap contains merges and deploys and is drawn as the band between the total boundary and authored line. 208 active weeks. COMMITS / WEEK · SQRT. The complete lifetime record covers 477 weekly buckets through the last completed day.
